description: This file manages drag and drop operations on a requirement specification tree within the TestLink project. It initializes parameters, interacts with a tree manager class, and performs database updates based on actions like changing parent nodes or reordering nodes.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: A class managing tree structures within the application, providing methods for changing parent relationships and reordering nodes.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and gathers request arguments for the drag-and-drop actions, sanitizing inputs.
